points: Pose-node hot path is PalletPoseNode::on_pair -> estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, and it poses only the one candidate select_detection already picked, so extra detections do not multiply stage 2. The dominant cost is the bilinear chamfer grid in coarse_chamfer_search_v2 / coarse_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior (OpenMP schedule(static) over a flattened theta-y-x loop).

With EstimatePoseParams defaults the free search is two full grids: coarse 21 x 31 x 31 = 20181 poses (dx/dy +/-0.15 m at 0.01 m, yaw +/-10 deg at 1 deg) then fine 13 x 25 x 25 = 8125 poses (+/-0.012 m at 0.001 m, +/-1.2 deg at 0.2 deg), 28306 evaluations. Each stage also pays one extra chamfer_cost_v2 on the seed pose before the loop.

The prior search is a second two-stage grid and it runs unless the free cost is already about 6.2 mm or better. lambda_eff = 3.0 * (1 - clamp((0.020 - free_cost) / 0.014, 0, 1)) and the prior is skipped only when lambda_eff <= 0.05. Prior coarse is 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261 (translation window +/-0.10 m, same 21 yaw samples) plus the same 8125 fine poses, 17386 more evaluations. The common frame therefore does about 45700 grid evaluations, not 28306.

Default prototype contour_spacing_m=0.03 yields N=182 points (outer 1.20 x 0.14 m -> 94 samples, two 0.47 x 0.10 m pockets -> 44 each). Every evaluation is O(N log N): chamfer_cost_from_rotated deep-copies the rotated Nx2 matrix into tls.translated, bilinear-samples all N points, copies all N distances into a vector, and std::sorts the whole vector even though trim_fraction=0.10 keeps only ceil(0.9*N)=164. Rotation is cached per theta; the Nx2 translation copy and the full sort are not. Prototype build itself is a static shape cache and is not per frame.

Before the search, sample_face_points scans every depth pixel. Vendored camera.yaml is depth 640x480 and RGB 1920x1080, so each pair walks 307200 pixels (K_inv ray, SE3 into RGB, pinhole project, mask test) and then copies accepted points from per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> into an Eigen::MatrixXd one row at a time. Buckets reserve Hd*Wd/4 Vector3d total (~1.8 MB) regardless of bbox size. build_bbox_mask zero-fills a full 1920x1080 mask and erodes that whole image erode_px=2 times.

depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole 640x480 depth buffer into a new CV_32FC1 Mat on every synced pair. ransac_plane_fit (default 100 iterations, early stop at inlier ratio 0.85) allocates a residual array and a bool mask per iteration, gathers inliers into a fresh matrix for JacobiSVD, then the pipeline calls plane_inlier_mask and gathers those same inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates another (N,3) relative matrix plus the (N,2) result.

The distance image is inflated by padding_m=0.80 at resolution_m=0.005: padding alone is 1.60 m, so the raster is at least 321 x 321 (~1.0e5 pixels) and about 561 x 350 (~2.0e5 pixels) for a 1.20 m by 0.14 m face. close_mask clones the mask, runs MORPH_ELLIPSE close, then connectedComponentsWithStats and a second full mask. compute_distance_transform_v2 uses cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE and convertTo into another CV_32FC1 image. That OpenCV path is secondary to the 4e4 chamfer evaluations.

Production detector dependency is TensorRT plus pycuda, not the mock backend: full_pipeline.launch.py loads detector.yaml backend=tensorrt, input 640, engine pallet_rtdetrv2_r18vd_640. Stage-1 host traffic on a 1920x1080 rgb8 frame is bytes(msg.data) (~6.2 MB) plus a contiguous RGB array, cv2.resize to 640, a float32 CHW copy (1x3x640x640, ~4.9 MB), another astype/copyto into pagelocked host memory, HtoD, DtoH, and a .copy() of each output tensor. The GPU engine is the stage-1 cost; the pose process still pays the chamfer grids after message_filters sync.
